_comment: Internal creative selection only (brief section 4.5); judged on the rendered concept cards (Play mask at 512/96/48 px on light and dark, circle/squircle/teardrop launcher masks, themed icon). Weights: small-size legibility 30, game identity and mechanic 25, distinctiveness beside the researched icons 20, polish 15, adaptive/themed robustness 10. Not a claim about store conversion.

concepts.title: A. Costume hero
concepts.thesis: The player wearing the Teal Dinosaur outfit with its Iron Sword, full figure: silhouette, face and blade all survive 48 px; teal against warm light. Weak points: a 2x sparkle that reads as a medical plus, a floating shadow, a dark field that recedes on dark surfaces.

concepts.title: B. Loot drop
concepts.thesis: The boss's two real drops (Iron Sword icon x2, outfit portrait x1): says loot, but the doubled sword dominates and the dinosaur shrinks to a detail; the portrait leaves the 66 dp safe zone (16.3 of 14.67 units) and the sword is clipped by every mask.

concepts.title: C. Close-up
concepts.thesis: The outfitted player at x2, cropped bust: bold, but the crop removes the T-rex silhouette, the sword and the costume reading; at 48 px it is a teal block with two eyes.

concepts.title: FINAL (A refined)
concepts.thesis: A with a brighter amber sunset (holds on dark surfaces beside the researched icons), no floating shadow, three 1x loot twinkles at the blade, and a themed icon that keeps the outer outline and carves only the interior details.
